ui.foot: Tithombe letincane te-YouTube temphakatsi kuphela. Akukho akhawunti, akukho kulayisha vidiyo, akukho kulandzela ema-URL lanamatselwe.
ui.heroIntro: Layisha tithombe te-YouTube ne-masinyane ngekuhle kakhulu lokukhona, mahhala. Khipha uphinde ugcine tithombe te-HD kunoma ngiyiphi vidiyo ye-YouTube yemphakatsi, Shorts, noma i-URL ye-ngekuchafata kanye. Namatsela linki ngehansi, chafata Tfola sithombe lesincane, bese ulayisha noma ubhace linki lelungile.
ui.INVALID_URL: Namatsela i-URL yemphakatsi ye-YouTube noma ye-(tithombe te-TikTok/Instagram atikasekelwa).
ui.UNSUPPORTED_HOST: Nyalo kusekelwe ema-URL emphakatsi e-YouTube ne-kuphela.
ui.INVALID_VIDEO_ID: Ayikafolakali i-ID yevidiyo lecinile kuloyo linki.
ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: Asikafolakali sithombe lesincane semphakatsi sale vidiyo.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Liphutsa lenethiwekhi limise kusesha. Phindza uzame.
ui.TIMEOUT: Sikhatsi sekusesha sithombe lesincane siphelile. Phindza uzame.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Sithombe lesincane asikhonanga kucinisekiswa njengesithombe lesicinile.
ui.CHANNEL_OR_PLAYLIST: Namatsela ema-URL evidiyo, hhayi linki yechannel noma yeluhlu.
